video_title: Greatest Game Ever?! Draymond Green Reacts to Knicks vs Spurs Finals Game 4 Comeback

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green evaluates the dumber play between De'Aaron Fox and J.R. Smith
quotes.excerpt: I still have to say it's J.R. because De'Aaron Fox's play, it's like a judgment play.
quotes.quote: I still have to say it's J.R. because De'Aaron Fox's play, it's like a judgment play. It's like, 'I can beat them, we're going to go up three, they'll need a three in order to tie the game and go to overtime.' So I guarantee us at least a path to overtime. And OG Anunoby just made an incredible play.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green criticizes De'Aaron Fox's decision-making in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: They inbounded the basketball to Fox, and he threw it faster than I would have liked.
quotes.quote: They inbounded the basketball to Fox, and he threw it faster than I would have liked to Stefan Castle. Stefan Castle goes to the free throw line, knocks the two free throws down, they move on.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green questions De'Aaron Fox's decision to go for a layup
quotes.excerpt: You think about the layup, and the natural thing that's going to happen if he dribbles out.
quotes.quote: You think about the layup, and the natural thing that's going to happen if he dribbles out is he's going to get fouled. And I don't know if it was a matter of he just wasn't confident in taking the free throws at that time, because when I watch that play during Game 3 and he got off it so fast, and then to watch this play in Game 4 and he goes for the layup as opposed to dribbling it out, I was very shocked by that.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green discusses the danger of championship experience narratives
quotes.excerpt: That type of loss can derail what you're possibly going to become.
quotes.quote: That type of loss can derail what you're possibly going to become. And what I meant by that was the mindset of the Spurs. When you hear people talk about championship experience, you say, 'Yo, they got championship experience.' Most people don't know what the hell it means. So let me tell you what it means. When you talk about championship experience, yes, obviously you've won a championship, you have championship experience. But what that term really means is in order to win a championship, you've gone through so much shit. You've gone through so much shit that by the time you win a championship, you've probably seen just about all the scenarios you could possibly see.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green praises Mike Brown's adjustment to play Jose Alvarado
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown did something great in the second half. He started playing Jose Alvarado next to Jalen Brunson.
quotes.quote: Mike Brown did something great in the second half. He started playing Jose Alvarado next to Jalen Brunson, allowing him to be another ball-handler. All of a sudden, Brunson isn't facing 94 feet of pressure. And you have to ask yourself the question, was Mike Brown right for benching Michael Bridges? Obviously they won, the answer is yes, but even if they lost, the answer is yes. Michael Bridges was not playing well. Michael Bridges also did not play well in Game 3.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green apologizes to Jalen Brunson for his past criticism
quotes.excerpt: I apologize to Jalen Brunson, and the reason I apologize to Jalen Brunson is because I think.
quotes.quote: I apologize to Jalen Brunson, and the reason I apologize to Jalen Brunson is because I think he's about to go on and win the NBA Finals, and I don't know that I'm going to have the opportunity to see him face-to-face, and I wanted to say it to his face. And the reason I said that is because I've been very critical of Jalen Brunson, just not thinking that, hey man, he's this 1A guy. And here's the thing with y'all have to understand about me. When I say 1A, when I say 1A, what I'm saying is no matter what team you go to, you're the guy. Ala Steph Curry, ala LeBron James, ala Luka Doncic, Kawhi. Like there's only really five to seven 1As in all of the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green critiques Charles Barkley's street meat recommendation
quotes.excerpt: I tried Chuck's famous street meat with the white sauce, and I must tell you that shit.
quotes.quote: I tried Chuck's famous street meat with the white sauce, and I must tell you that shit was garbage. I mean, when they showed the video of what he be talking about, the food looked awful. I'm like, 'I got to try this meat.' It was pathetic. I mean, pathetic. It was awful. I can't believe Charles Barkley, who's been rich now, Charles Barkley has been rich for a whopping like 40 years, and he's eating dog food.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green recounts Shaq's reaction to the Spurs' three-point shooting
quotes.excerpt: They better not shoot another three. And I'm sitting there like, 'Yeah, they definitely got three happy.'
quotes.quote: They better not shoot another three. And I'm sitting there like, 'Yeah, they definitely got three happy.' Because the first quarter they were rolling, they were hitting every three. Beginning of the second, rolling, hitting every three. But then you can start seeing like they just start going for the three. And both of them was like, 'Yo, they better not shoot another three.' And Chuck's like, 'If I'm Miss Johnson, I'm I'm calling timeout right now, and I'm telling these dumb M-Fers, if they shoot another three, I'm subbing their ass out the fucking game.'

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green analyzes De'Aaron Fox's performance in the Spurs' collapse
quotes.excerpt: Six for 16 from the field, not that important. Mindless turnovers in the clutch.
quotes.quote: Six for 16 from the field, not that important. Mindless turnovers in the clutch, definitely got to be better there. The decision to shoot the layup, that's a bang-bang decision. Not a smart play, very bang-bang. If he makes the layup, no one's complaining, results-driven. If he misses the layup like he did, everyone's like, 'Yo, he cost them the season.'

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green critiques Wembanyama's performance and leadership
quotes.excerpt: From the moment Wembanyama started telling Mitchell Robinson, 'I'm in your head,' the Knicks outscored the Spurs.
quotes.quote: From the moment Wembanyama started telling Mitchell Robinson, 'I'm in your head,' the Knicks outscored the Spurs 87 to 69. Wembanyama scored 14 more points and was four for 17 from the field. Two big missed free throws towards the end of the game from a great free throw shooter. Listen, I love somebody who talk that shit and back it up, and Wembanyama been talking and talking, and he's been walking the walk for the most part. He failed last night. 29 point lead, say you the face, say you great, all those things, 29 point lead, you got to be able to stop the bleeding at some point, and he did not do that.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green critiques Miss Johnson's coaching decisions
quotes.excerpt: 20 to 4 run before you take a timeout with a young team like that.
quotes.quote: 20 to 4 run before you take a timeout with a young team like that, I can't agree with. Never adjusted in the second half. Rotations were not great. There were times where they had a big enough lead to get Wembanyama a rest, and he didn't. He left Wembanyama in. And if you grab him a rest in some of those spots where you could have, maybe down the stretch he could do some of the things that I was just talking about, but he played and he played. And as a guy who hasn't played a ton of minutes, the most minutes he's ever played has been coming in these playoffs, I think you could have pulled him some rest and he could have been fresher down the stretch.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green predicts OG Anunoby will win Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: I see a lot of people saying OG Anunoby, it is the current favorite for the Finals MVP.
quotes.quote: I see a lot of people saying OG Anunoby, it is the current favorite for the Finals MVP, and I must say, I agree. I think he's been the most consistent. I think, you know, he's made pivotal plays. He had the block and the bucket to to close out the game in Game 4. Jalen Brunson was incredible last game, but I think the first three games he he wasn't great. Was shooting a lot of shots at a low percentage. And OG has just been constant. And it hasn't been like averaging 14 points, 16 points. He's averaging 24 points on the series. 65% from the field, 55 from three. Playing the defense he's playing, guarding Wembanyama at time in the series. I think OG Anunoby have a decent Game 5 and they win Game 5, I think OG Anunoby is the Finals MVP.
